# Purpose

Three procedures all withhold recent data and re-run the assessment. They answer different questions. Mixing them up is a common review error.

Source: peel-back section of `C:/work/papers/04_ideas/3diags/3diagsV4.tex`.

| Procedure | Quantity scored | Reference | Failure mode |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Retrospective** | Latent states (SSB, F, R) | Full-data estimates | Internal inconsistency as years are added |
| **Hindcast** | Observable indices / CPUE | Withheld observations | No prediction skill (External) |
| **Backtest** | Full management strategy | Management objectives | Strategy fails closed-loop (Robustness of advice) |

# Change this block

```{r inputs}
# Which peel-back story to walk:
#   "retrospective"  Mohn's rho; within-model peels
#   "hindcast"       MASE vs persistence; withheld index years
#   "backtest"       assessment + HCR replayed on history
# Course link:
#   "blue_shark"     catch series / green cell story
#   "shortfin_mako"  ensemble projections and risk tolerance

procedure <- "hindcast"
```

```{r catalogue, echo=FALSE}
catalogue <- list(
  retrospective = list(
    label = "Within-model retrospective",
    strand = "Internal (consistency of estimates over peels)",
    do = c(
      "Refit ending in Y, Y-1, …, Y-n with everything else fixed",
      "Compare terminal-year estimates from each peel to the same year in the full run",
      "Summarise with Mohn's rho; investigate |rho| > ~0.20 (long-lived) or ~0.30 (short-lived)"
    ),
    not = c(
      "Not a historical retrospective of successive published assessments (those confound data, model, and team)",
      "A low rho is necessary but not sufficient: the model can be internally consistent and still wrong"
    ),
    mse = "Persistent patterns should be reproducible in the OM if the assessment is used inside an MP.",
    leave_with = "rho and the pattern for SSB and F. State whether the pattern would change the advice."
  ),
  hindcast = list(
    label = "Hindcast cross-validation",
    strand = "External (prediction skill on observables)",
    do = c(
      "For each peel, refit to data up to Y-p and predict withheld index/CPUE years",
      "Score with MASE against a naive persistence forecast",
      "MASE < 1: useful skill; MASE ≥ 1: no better than persistence"
    ),
    not = c(
      "Not the same as residual plots on fitted years",
      "Not a test of latent SSB against itself"
    ),
    mse = "If the assessment cannot hindcast the data stream the MP will see, the OM/observation model is a weak basis for claiming robustness.",
    leave_with = "MASE by index. Name the series with no skill."
  ),
  backtest = list(
    label = "Backtesting the management strategy",
    strand = "Robustness of the full advice loop",
    do = c(
      "Year by year: assess with only then-available data, apply the HCR, implement catch, step forward",
      "Score P(SSB < Blim), P(F > FMSY), mean yield, advice stability",
      "Use the same objectives as the MSE"
    ),
    not = c(
      "Not only re-fitting the assessment: the HCR and implementation are part of the test",
      "Not a substitute for a designed MSE, but the empirical counterpart on history"
    ),
    mse = "Backtesting is closed-loop on history; MSE is closed-loop on an OM. Both ask whether the strategy meets objectives.",
    leave_with = "Whether the candidate strategy would have met the risk tolerance on the historical path."
  ),
  blue_shark = list(
    label = "IOTC blue shark — which peel-back matters",
    strand = "External scale of catch + Robustness of 'no increase'",
    do = c(
      "Internal: residual and retrospective checks on the SS3 base case",
      "External: hindcast CPUE; confront nominal vs reconstructed catch as independent scale evidence",
      "Robustness: projections under catch multipliers on the reconstructed series"
    ),
    not = c(
      "Do not treat the green cell as validation of the catch history",
      "Do not call residual agreement a hindcast"
    ),
    mse = "Advice is precautionary because of catch-series uncertainty, not because Internal diagnostics failed.",
    leave_with = "Sentence: green status, advice driven by which catch series, which peel-back would move it."
  ),
  shortfin_mako = list(
    label = "IOTC shortfin mako — ensemble as robustness",
    strand = "Robustness (weight of evidence) + External (discards / PRM)",
    do = c(
      "Internal: residuals per ensemble member",
      "External: dead discards and post-release mortality in the catch currency",
      "Robustness: nine-model cloud; P(green in 10 years) at 1,217 t with stated risk tolerance"
    ),
    not = c(
      "Do not report only the median cell when ~half the ensemble disagrees",
      "Do not treat a projection that omits discards as the same backtest"
    ),
    mse = "The catch limit is a total-mortality strategy. Backtests and projections must use that currency.",
    leave_with = "Risk tolerance, catch currency (landings vs total deaths), and ensemble weight in the red cell."
  )
)

if (!procedure %in% names(catalogue)) {
  stop("procedure must be one of: ", paste(names(catalogue), collapse = ", "))
}
ex <- catalogue[[procedure]]
```

# 1. The procedure you selected

```{r show, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Item = c("Procedure", "Strand", "They leave with"),
    Value = c(ex$label, ex$strand, ex$leave_with)
  ),
  col.names = c("Item", "Value")
)
```

## Do

```{r do, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(data.frame(Do = ex$do), col.names = "Do")
```

## Do not confuse with

```{r not, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(data.frame(`Do not` = ex$not), col.names = "Do not")
```

**MSE link.** `r ex$mse`

# 2. Place each peel-back on the three strands

```{r map, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Procedure = c("Retrospective", "Hindcast", "Backtest"),
    Strand = c("Internal", "External", "Robustness"),
    Score = c(
      "Mohn's rho; peel pattern for SSB, F",
      "MASE (or equivalent) on withheld indices",
      "Objective metrics under the HCR on history"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)
```

Self-test (simulate from the fitted model, refit) stays under **Internal**. It is not a substitute for hindcast or backtest.

# 3. Your case

```{r their-case}
their_stock <- "type the stock name"
have_retro  <- "missing"   # pass | partial | fail | missing
have_hindcast <- "missing"
have_backtest <- "missing"
which_moves_advice <- "retro / hindcast / backtest / none yet"
```

```{r their-table, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Item = c(
      "Stock", "Retrospective", "Hindcast", "Backtest",
      "Which would move the advice"
    ),
    Value = c(
      their_stock, have_retro, have_hindcast, have_backtest,
      which_moves_advice
    )
  ),
  col.names = c("Item", "Value")
)
```

Knit once with `procedure <- "retrospective"`, once with `"hindcast"`, once with `"backtest"`. Then set `procedure` to `blue_shark` or `shortfin_mako` and fill section 3.

Someone without a case uses `shortfin_mako`: retrospective often partial, hindcast often missing in the summary, backtest/projection present as the 10-year green probability at 1,217 t.
